Fiction.Bank:Pl7.Fields.AssetCode:assetC: GV-1-E: Debt issued by the National Treasury of Fictonia; Tier 1.
GV-2-E: Debt issued by a Fictonian government agency with an explicit National Treasury guarantee; Tier 1.
CB-0-E: Securities issued or guaranteed by a central bank, credit quality step 1; Tier 1.
SV-0-E: Debt issued by a foreign sovereign, credit quality step 1; Tier 1.
SV-2-E: Debt issued by a foreign sovereign, credit quality step 2; Tier 2.
SN-1-E: Debt issued by a supranational entity or multilateral development bank; Tier 2.
RG-1-E: Debt issued by a Fictonian province; Tier 2.
CR-1-E: Investment-grade debt issued by a non-financial corporate; Tier 3.
EQ-1-E: Ordinary shares in the FX-200 index of the Fictonian Exchange; Tier 3.
SN-1: Supranational or development-bank debt that fails the Rule 14.6 tests; not eligible.
EQ-1: FX-200 ordinary shares that fail the Rule 14.6 tests; not eligible.
EQ-2: All other listed ordinary shares; not eligible.
MU-1: Debt issued by a municipality; never eligible under Rule 14, whatever its rating.
ZZ-9: All other assets; not eligible.
Fiction.Bank:Pl7.Fields.AssetCode:tier.t: Tier 1: the highest-quality assets, counted at full market value.
Tier 2: counted at 80% of market value, subject to the Tier 2 and 3 limit.
Tier 3: counted at 40% of market value, subject to the Tier 2 and 3 limit and the Tier 3 limit.
Not eligible: excluded from the stock of eligible liquid assets.
Fiction.Bank:Pl7.Tables.LiquidAssets:unr: Record ID: the bank's identifier for the reported asset line.
Asset code: the code from the Schedule B asset code table.
Market value: the IFRS 13 fair value at close of business on the reporting date, in millions of FCR.
Liquidity desk control: whether the asset meets the operational requirements of Rule 14.7 (Yes = true).
